It's your Pastor Curtis here, and I want to remind you to join us for worship this month. Every First Saturday, we gather in person at 24301 Telegraph in Southfield, Michigan, at 12 Noon. We'll lift our voices, receive healing, and be empowered for the battles ahead.

But it's not just once a month – we also gather daily online for our Hour of Power. Join us Monday through Friday at 8:15 AM on Facebook Live for a powerful dose of spiritual nourishment.

Who's joining us for worship this week?
